failure_codes.G1: missed or unstable grasp (an arm never grasped, or dropped its unplaced corner)
failure_codes.G2: slip: an arm lost its corner while its jaws were still commanded closed (friction grasp only)
failure_codes.G3: split stack: the layers of a stacked corner carried together ended > 2 x SUCCESS_DIST apart (Q2)
failure_codes.M1: motion error: anchor corner dragged or sim unstable
failure_codes.F1: fold placed with poor alignment (released off target)
failure_codes.S1: stalled: timed out still holding / hovering
